name: Scotia Momentum No-Fee Visa Card

apr.notes: 20.99% on purchases; 22.99% on cash advances, balance transfers and cash-like transactions.

credit_required.notes: Canadian resident who has reached the age of majority in their province or territory.

base_rate.description: 0.5% cash back on all other eligible purchases and on accelerated categories after the annual spend limit.

categories.label: Grocery, gas, EV charging, transit, rideshare, food delivery, drugstores and recurring bill payments (up to $15,000 annual spend)

rewards.redemption_notes: Cash back is deposited to the account once a year in November.

signup_bonus.description: Welcome offer of 5% cash back on up to $2,000 in purchases in the first 3 months.

notes: The issuer page does not name a network package tier, so network_tier is none.
